using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using Tedd.DotNetLab.Contracts;
using Tedd.DotNetLab.Harness;
using Before = Snapshot.Voxtree;
using After = Tedd.Voxtree;
FixtureMode.Validation=args[0]=="--validate";
if(OperatingSystem.IsWindows())Process.GetCurrentProcess().ProcessorAffinity=(nint)4;
var registry=new ScenarioRegistry();
foreach(var pattern in new[]{"mixed-u16-air","mixed-u7-air","mixed-u8-air","uniform-u7-empty"})
foreach(var op in new[]{"construct","build","callerbuild","trybuild","required","fromencoded","copy","validate","count","miss","buildread"})
{registry.Register(new BulkUInt32Scenario(pattern,op));registry.Register(new BulkUInt16Scenario(pattern,op));}
foreach(var op in new[]{"count7","miss7","count17","miss17"}){registry.Register(new BulkUInt32Scenario("mixed-u16-air",op));registry.Register(new BulkUInt16Scenario("mixed-u16-air",op));}
if(args[0]=="--validate"){
 foreach(var d in registry.Describe()){
  var scenario=(ISynchronousScenario)registry.Get(d.Id);
  foreach(var variant in new[]{"baseline","candidate"}){
   scenario.Prepare(new ScenarioContext(variant,CancellationToken.None));scenario.Reset(new ResetContext(ResetLevel.LogicalState));
   scenario.ExecuteBatch(2);if(!scenario.Validate().Correct)throw new Exception(d.Id+variant);scenario.Cleanup();
  }
  Console.WriteLine(d.Id+" valid");
 }
 return;
}
var host=new HarnessHost(registry,args[1]);
if(args[0]=="--harness-owned"||Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DOTNET_EnableDiagnostics")=="0")await host.RunOwnedAsync();
else{
 Console.WriteLine(Wire.Serialize(host.Target));using var cancel=new CancellationTokenSource();
 _=Task.Run(async()=>{await Console.In.ReadLineAsync();cancel.Cancel();});await host.ListenAsync(cancel.Token);
}
public static class FixtureMode{public static bool Validation;}

public sealed class BulkUInt32Scenario : ISynchronousScenario
{
    readonly string pattern,op;
    readonly uint[] values;
    readonly byte[] lods;
    readonly uint[] destination = new uint[32768];
    readonly byte[] buffer = new byte[After.Octree.GetMaximumSize(5)];
    Before.Octree before = null!;
    After.Octree after = null!;
    byte[] originalBefore = null!,originalAfter = null!;
    bool baseline,initialized,beforePrimed,afterPrimed;
    long sum,completed,readFold;
    int zeros;
    public BulkUInt32Scenario(string pattern,string op)
    {
        this.pattern=pattern;this.op=op;
        var raw=ForcecraftCorpus.Load(pattern);
        values=raw.Select(v=>(uint)v).ToArray();lods=ForcecraftCorpus.Lods(raw);
        zeros=values.Count(v=>v==0);
        for(int i=0;i<32768;i++)readFold=unchecked(readFold+(long)values[i]+((long)lods[i]<<32));
    }
    public ScenarioDescriptor Describe()=>new($"bulk-UInt32-L5-{pattern}-{op}","17",
        Wire.Hash(new{pattern,op,voxelSha256=ForcecraftCorpus.Hash(pattern),affinity=4,primeMs=3000,buildReads=65536,layout="linear",consumer="complete-public-operation-with-result-fold"}),
        ResetLevel.LogicalState,ThreadAffinity.Any,false,
        op=="buildread"?"One owned construction plus 65536 sequential public value/LOD reads":
        op is "construct" or "fromencoded"?"One owned construction or FromEncoded plus first public Get":
        "One complete public bulk operation, with returned result or copied element consumed",["baseline","candidate"]);
    int ExpectedClipped(int endZ,uint wanted){int count=0;
        for(int x=1;x<31;x++)for(int y=1;y<31;y++)for(int z=1;z<endZ;z++)if((uint)values[(x*32+y)*32+z]==wanted)count++;
        return count;
    }
    void Initialize()
    {
        if(initialized)return;
        before=new Before.Octree(5,values);after=new After.Octree(5,values);
        originalBefore=before.Data.ToArray();originalAfter=after.Data.ToArray();
        CheckTrees(); initialized=true;
    }
    void CheckTrees()
    {
        for(int i=0;i<32768;i++)
        {
            int x=i/1024,y=i/32%32,z=i%32;
            if(before.Get(x,y,z,out int b)!=values[i]||after.Get(x,y,z,out int a)!=values[i]||b!=lods[i]||a!=lods[i])throw new Exception("Bulk dense/LOD oracle");
        }
        if(!before.AsSpan().IsWellFormed()||!after.AsSpan().IsWellFormed())throw new Exception("Bulk validation oracle");
    }
    public void Prepare(ScenarioContext context)
    {
        Initialize();baseline=context.Variant=="baseline";
        if(!FixtureMode.Validation && !(baseline?beforePrimed:afterPrimed))
        {
            var clock=Stopwatch.StartNew();
            do{ExecuteBatch(1);}while(clock.ElapsedMilliseconds<3000);
            if(baseline)beforePrimed=true;else afterPrimed=true;
        }
    }
    public void Reset(ResetContext context){sum=completed=0;}
    public long ExecuteBatch(int count)
    {
#if PRIMARY_BASELINE_CALLER
        AfterBatch(count);
#else
        if(baseline)BeforeBatch(count);else AfterBatch(count);
#endif
        completed+=count;return count;
    }
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)] void BeforeBatch(int count){switch(op){case "count7":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+before.CountMatches(new Before.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,8),Before.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(0)));}return;case "miss7":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+before.CountMatches(new Before.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,8),Before.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(65535)));}return;case "count17":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+before.CountMatches(new Before.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,18),Before.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(0)));}return;case "miss17":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+before.CountMatches(new Before.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,18),Before.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(65535)));}return;case "construct":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){before=new Before.Octree(5,values);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)before.Get(0,0,0));}return;case "build":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){before.Build(values);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)before.Get(0,0,0));}return;case "callerbuild":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+Before.Octree.Build(values,5,buffer));}return;case "trybuild":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){if(!Before.Octree.TryBuild(values,5,buffer,out int written))throw new Exception("Build failed");sum=unchecked(sum+written);}return;case "required":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+Before.Octree.GetRequiredSize(values,5));}return;case "fromencoded":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){before=Before.Octree.FromEncoded(originalBefore);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)before.Get(0,0,0));}return;case "copy":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){before.CopyTo(destination);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)destination[2047]);}return;case "validate":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){if(!before.AsSpan().IsWellFormed())throw new Exception("Validation failed");sum=unchecked(sum+1);}return;case "count":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+before.CountMatches(new Before.VoxelBox(0,0,0,32,32,32),Before.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(0)));}return;case "miss":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+before.CountMatches(new Before.VoxelBox(0,0,0,32,32,32),Before.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(65535)));}return;case "buildread":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){before=new Before.Octree(5,values);for(int j=0;j<65536;j++){int p=j&32767;var value=before.Get(p/1024,p/32%32,p%32,out int lod);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)value+((long)lod<<32));}}return;default:throw new Exception("Unknown bulk op");}}
[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)] void AfterBatch(int count){switch(op){case "count7":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+after.CountMatches(new After.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,8),After.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(0)));}return;case "miss7":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+after.CountMatches(new After.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,8),After.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(65535)));}return;case "count17":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+after.CountMatches(new After.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,18),After.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(0)));}return;case "miss17":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+after.CountMatches(new After.VoxelBox(1,1,1,31,31,18),After.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(65535)));}return;case "construct":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){after=new After.Octree(5,values);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)after.Get(0,0,0));}return;case "build":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){after.Build(values);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)after.Get(0,0,0));}return;case "callerbuild":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+After.Octree.Build(values,5,buffer));}return;case "trybuild":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){if(!After.Octree.TryBuild(values,5,buffer,out int written))throw new Exception("Build failed");sum=unchecked(sum+written);}return;case "required":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+After.Octree.GetRequiredSize(values,5));}return;case "fromencoded":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){after=After.Octree.FromEncoded(originalAfter);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)after.Get(0,0,0));}return;case "copy":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){after.CopyTo(destination);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)destination[2047]);}return;case "validate":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){if(!after.AsSpan().IsWellFormed())throw new Exception("Validation failed");sum=unchecked(sum+1);}return;case "count":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+after.CountMatches(new After.VoxelBox(0,0,0,32,32,32),After.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(0)));}return;case "miss":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){sum=unchecked(sum+after.CountMatches(new After.VoxelBox(0,0,0,32,32,32),After.VoxelFilter.EqualTo(65535)));}return;case "buildread":for(int i=0;i<count;i++){after=new After.Octree(5,values);for(int j=0;j<65536;j++){int p=j&32767;var value=after.Get(p/1024,p/32%32,p%32,out int lod);sum=unchecked(sum+(long)value+((long)lod<<32));}}return;default:throw new Exception("Unknown bulk op");}}
    public ValidationResult Validate()
    {
        CheckTrees();
        long expected=op switch{
            "construct" or "build" or "fromencoded"=>(long)values[0],
            "callerbuild" or "trybuild" or "required"=>baseline?originalBefore.Length:originalAfter.Length,
            "copy"=>(long)values[2047],"validate"=>1,"count"=>zeros,"miss"=>values.Count(v=>v==65535),"count7"=>ExpectedClipped(8,0),"miss7"=>ExpectedClipped(8,65535),"count17"=>ExpectedClipped(18,0),"miss17"=>ExpectedClipped(18,65535),
            "buildread"=>unchecked(readFold*2),_=>throw new Exception("Unknown bulk op")};
        if(op=="copy"&&!destination.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(values))return new(false);
        if(op is "callerbuild" or "trybuild")
        {
            var original=baseline?originalBefore:originalAfter;
            if(!buffer.AsSpan(0,original.Length).SequenceEqual(original))return new(false);
        }
        return new(sum==unchecked(expected*completed));
    }
    public void Cleanup(){}
}

public static class ForcecraftCorpus {
    public static string Hash(string name)=>name switch {"mixed-u16-air"=>"48A799A3EEBA729CB9DCE28F1EA54E9B19A9D46E7AA7CA8F0696E90E0F6F10FB","mixed-u7-air"=>"87DB869D775B6A5525CAA5E55463CCC8F4A0F56F6D6770EC5A336E7F63F421DE","mixed-u8-air"=>"5FFD2CF86EF7B6527F314734C048ADCC08C5924C01D2B9C93ABAF1C6814DB8D7","uniform-u7-empty"=>"DE2F256064A0AF797747C2B97505DC0B9F3DF0DE4F489EAC731C23AE9CA9CC31",_=>throw new ArgumentException(name)};
    public static ushort[] Load(string name) {
        var text=name switch {"mixed-u16-air"=>"","mixed-u7-air"=>"","mixed-u8-air"=>"H4sIAAAAAAAC/+3QMQ0AAAwDoPr3UK81sWcJSCABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAgFtVAAAvDeb4mNcAAAEA","uniform-u7-empty"=>"H4sIAAAAAAAC/+3BAQEAAACAkP6v7ggKAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAauuOl9cAAAEA",_=>throw new ArgumentException(name)};
        using var input=new MemoryStream(Convert.FromBase64String(text));
        using var gzip=new System.IO.Compression.GZipStream(input,System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode.Decompress);
        var bytes=new byte[65536];gzip.ReadExactly(bytes);if(gzip.ReadByte()!=-1)throw new Exception("Sample size");
        if(Convert.ToHexString(System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.HashData(bytes))!=Hash(name))throw new Exception("Sample hash");
        var values=new ushort[32768];for(var i=0;i<values.Length;i++)values[i]=System.Buffers.Binary.BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(bytes.AsSpan(i*2));return values;
    }
    public static byte[] Lods(ushort[] values) {
        var lods=new byte[values.Length];
        void Visit(int x,int y,int z,int level) {
            var width=1<<level;var first=values[(x*32+y)*32+z];var uniform=true;
            for(var a=x;a<x+width&&uniform;a++)for(var b=y;b<y+width&&uniform;b++)for(var c=z;c<z+width;c++)if(values[(a*32+b)*32+c]!=first){uniform=false;break;}
            if(uniform){for(var a=x;a<x+width;a++)for(var b=y;b<y+width;b++)Array.Fill(lods,(byte)level,(a*32+b)*32+z,width);return;}
            if(level==0)throw new Exception("LOD oracle");var half=width/2;
            for(var a=0;a<2;a++)for(var b=0;b<2;b++)for(var c=0;c<2;c++)Visit(x+a*half,y+b*half,z+c*half,level-1);
        }
        Visit(0,0,0,5);return lods;
    }
}
